You're joining an ongoing research project in /home/sprite/github-gigs (a git repo with commits — read SUMMARY.md, DEEP_REVIEW.md, FINAL_VERDICT.md first for full context; do not repeat work already documented there).

## Background
The user is hunting for GitHub open-source projects that pay real money for closing issues (a "help wanted + bounty" model), inspired by team113/messenger (now archived). Early in this project we found one curated list, `kunovsky/paid-open-source-projects`, but a full audit found EVERY entry in it was dead/defunct (domains not resolving, programs discontinued years ago, docs pages 404). We have NOT yet searched for OTHER, possibly more current/different, curated lists that might exist on GitHub — there could be sibling "awesome" lists maintained by different people with different, less-picked-over entries.

## Your task
1. Search GitHub repos for other curated lists on this exact topic: try `topic:awesome` combined with keywords like "bounty", "paid", "freelance", "opensource" in the repo name/description/readme; try repo name searches like "awesome-paid-open-source", "paid-oss", "opensource-bounties", "github-bounties-list", "get-paid-open-source"; try `in:readme "projects that pay"`, `in:readme "pays contributors"`, `in:readme "open source bounty list"`.
2. For each list found, fetch its actual README content (via raw.githubusercontent.com, no GitHub API rate limit there) and extract every project it mentions.
3. Cross-reference against what's already been checked in this project (read FINAL_VERDICT.md and DEEP_REVIEW.md for the list of already-vetted dead projects: RudderStack, openScale, Etherpad, Conquest of Our Ancestors/multigen_game, AppFlowy, BountyBoard.dev, BusKill, Expensify, tscircuit, trigger.dev, celo-org, district0x, AncientBeast, unitystation — SKIP re-verifying these, only chase NEW entries not already covered).
4. For any NEW project mentioned in a newly-found list that hasn't been checked yet, run the full verification checklist:
   - Confirm repo is real/healthy: stars, recent pushed_at, not archived (`curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}`).
   - Confirm real currency (fiat or major liquid crypto), not a dead/invented token.
   - Confirm at least one CLOSED/paid issue exists under whatever convention it uses (real track record).
   - For open priced issues: check assignee + comment count/actual competition via GitHub API directly, not just trusting any list's claims.
   - Reject known farm patterns: <50 stars with large bounty claims, "sandbox"/"benchmark" in description, dead single-day commit history, "Autonomous/Autonomus Agents Only" labels, verbatim-cloned issue titles from real companies.

## Rate limits
Unauthenticated GitHub API: 60 core requests/hour, 10 search requests/min. Pace search calls ~7s apart, core calls ~2-3s apart. raw.githubusercontent.com fetches are NOT rate-limited by GitHub's API limits, use freely.

## Output
Write findings to a NEW file: /home/sprite/github-gigs/other_curated_lists_findings.md. List every list you found (even dead ones, briefly), and full detail on any genuinely good NEW candidate that passes verification.

Do NOT run git commands. Do NOT modify/delete existing files. Do NOT spawn further subagents.

Reply with a concise summary (under 300 words): how many lists you found, how many new (not-already-vetted) projects you checked, and your best candidate if any.

Из **всего**, что было найдено в раундах 1-2 (курируемый список +

обновлялось больше года).

Также обнаружена **отдельная проблема**: по всему GitHub расплодились
кластеры **фейковых баунти-репозиториев** (`123a-bcd/*`, `9904099/*`,
`xevrion-v2/agent-playground`, `SecureBananaLabs/bug-bounty`,
`coopfinance/coopfin-api` и др.) — свежесозданные репо с generic
названиями issues вида "feat: add X utility", массовым спамом ботов в
комментариях. Похоже на полигоны для тестирования AI-агентов на
способность самостоятельно находить и решать баунти, а не реальные
рабочие места. Игнорируй всё, что выглядит похоже.

конкретные alogra.io/{org}/bounties страницы небольших/новых компаний

дальше в поиске ещё вариантов, или archestra-ai уже закрывает вопрос?

# Итог: поиск GitHub-проектов с оплатой за issues

Твоя теория подтвердилась — таких проектов реально несколько десятков, просто нет
единого каталога, и большинство людей их не ищут через GitHub Search (хотя
`label:bounty` — это встроенная кросс-репозиторная фича GitHub, которой почти
никто не пользуется).

Полные сырые данные: `results.json` (298 репо, 111 репо с issues), красивая
таблица: `REPORT.md`. Скрипты: `scan_github_bounties.py` (поиск) +
`build_report.py` (отчёт) — можно перезапускать когда угодно.

## 1. Уже существующий курируемый список (для référence)

**kunovsky/paid-open-source-projects** — репозиторий-список именно того, что ты
описал. team113/messenger там НЕТ, что подтверждает: такие списки неполные и
полагаться только на них нельзя.

| Проект | Оплата | Как |
|---|---|---|
| RudderStack | $2000/баунти | github.com/rudderlabs/rudder-server |
| Expensify | $250-500/баунти | github.com/Expensify/App |
| BusKill | $2340 | github.com/BusKill/buskill-app |
| tscircuit | $5-300 (через Algora) | algora.io/tscircuit/bounties |

# Akong'a Labs OSS Bounties

We're building stuff. Want to help? Get paid.

## What's This About?

[Akong'a Labs](https://akongalabs.com) posts development tasks as GitHub issues. You build the solution, submit a PR, and if it works, you get paid. Simple.

First valid submission wins. No beauty contests, no politics.

## How It Works

1. **Browse Issues** - Check what bounties are available
2. **Build & Submit** - Create your solution, submit a PR  
3. **Get Paid** - First working solution gets the money

## ⚠️ Payment Reality Check

We ONLY pay via Binance (USDT/USDC). No PayPal, no bank transfers, no Bitcoin, no exceptions. 

Don't have Binance? Don't start working. 

Can't use Binance in your country? Sorry, these bounties aren't for you.

## Legal Stuff (The Important Bit)

Submit a PR = your code becomes open source. We can use it whether you win or not. That's the deal.

## What We Actually Need

**Tech Stack** (non-negotiable):
- React + Vite
- React Router V7  
- Node.js + Express
- PostgreSQL + Drizzle ORM
- TypeScript (no `any` types)
- Works with Bun (Yarn needs justification)

**Quality Bars**:
- Your code works
- Your code has tests for critical flows
- Your code explains itself (if we have to ask questions, you're out)
- You provide a working demo

**Starter Template**: [`saas-panda`](https://github.com/AkongaLabs/saas-panda) - use it or don't, up to you.

## Getting Started

1. Find a bounty in [Issues](../../issues)
2. Read it carefully (seriously, read the whole thing)
3. Ask questions in the issue comments BEFORE coding
4. Build your solution
5. Test everything  
6. Submit PR with the template from [docs/SUBMISSION.md](docs/SUBMISSION.md)
7. Tag `@adrianmurage` for review

**Quick Commands**:
```bash
# Clone starter (optional)
git clone git@github.com:AkongaLabs/saas-panda.git your-solution
cd your-solution
bun install
bun run dev
```

## AI Tools

We included a `.cursorrules` file for AI editors like Cursor. Use AI, don't use AI - whatever gets the job done.

## The Fine Print

**Detailed Info**:
- [Technical Requirements](docs/REQUIREMENTS.md) - Full tech specs and standards
- [Submission Process](docs/SUBMISSION.md) - How to submit properly
- [Payment Details](docs/PAYMENT.md) - Binance process, 6-month forfeiture policy
- [FAQ](docs/FAQ.md) - Common questions and AI tool guidance

**Get Disqualified If**:
- Missing requirements
- No tests
- Code doesn't work
- Late submission
- Can't receive Binance payments

**Communication**:
- Ask questions in GitHub issues (public only)
- No private messages, no emails
- Be specific, not vague

## Questions?

Read the [FAQ](docs/FAQ.md) first. Still confused? Ask in the relevant GitHub issue.

---

**tl;dr**: Build working code, follow the rules, get paid. First working solution wins.

- **Clear scope**: Contributors know exactly what's expected
